summary: Iteration 35: Full validation of Frasberg Cloud V1 multiverse simulation engine (backend /api/cloud/* + /cloud React console). Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass (genesis w/ all 4 physics models, tick, detail, migrate, trade valid+invalid, synthesize (with source deletion verified), congress propose+vote, kernel status w/ 5 absolute laws, delete+404). Frontend: /cloud page loads, kernel-status-bar, genesis-form, universe-grid, absolute-laws-panel all render; genesis form creates universes; tick-1/tick-10 buttons update cards & fire toasts; detail modal opens with agents/civs/myths/events lists and closes; multi-select surfaces multiverse-ops-bar; migrate, trade, and omni-synthesis all work (synthesis correctly removes both source cards and inserts merged card); congress resolution proposes and vote returns PASSED/FAILED pill. Regression: /api/keys still 200 for doctester1.

issues: Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1)' on initial mount for entropy/stability chart — cosmetic; chart still renders once container measures. Consider adding minHeight or forcing width/height numeric to silence warnings.

action_items: Optional: fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer -1 width warning in FrasbergCloud detail modal by providing explicit height/aspect.
critical_code_review_comments: frasberg_cloud.py is 552 lines and mixes engine simulation + API routing + Pydantic schemas + db access. Consider splitting into engine.py (pure sim), schemas.py, routes.py for maintainability once >700 lines.
cloud_universes documents can grow unbounded (metrics history capped at 60, myths at 20, agents at 60 — good). But cloud_events grows without bound; add TTL index or per-universe cap.
Congress vote outcome is purely random (random.random() < votes/(votes+5)) — acknowledged as intentional stochastic per problem statement.
MongoDB _id is set to universe id (string) — good, avoids ObjectId serialization; _id is popped from detail response — verified.
No auth on /api/cloud/* endpoints — acknowledged as public per problem statement. Consider rate-limit for production.
seed_data_creation: Created ~8 TEST_* universes during pytest run, cleaned up via test_cleanup + delete tests. Two UITest_* universes created via UI then fused via Omni-Synthesis (source cards removed automatically).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frasberg Cloud V1 is fully wired end-to-end. Backend router prefix /api/cloud on frasberg_cloud.py. Frontend page /cloud (FrasbergCloud.jsx). Universe cap 50, tick steps capped 25/call, congress voting is probabilistic. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter35_frasberg_cloud.py (13 tests, all pass in ~3s).
